acceptedDeviations.requirement: Keep the prototype’s Spring-styled Tailwind + Radix primitives (SettingCard, SpringSwitch, SpringConfirmDialog, etc.); @ringcentral/spring-ui is not installed and the task forbids redesigning the finalized UI.
Keep lucide-react utility glyphs (close X, chevrons, search, info) inside dialogs/controls; visual parity with the approved prototype takes precedence.
Keep Tailwind default-palette utilities used for the loading skeleton (slate-100), error banners (red-50/red-800), overlays (black/40) and white surfaces.
Admin Portal chrome (masthead, side nav, footer) intentionally uses the legacy Service Web UI palette (#0679BA, #2F2F2F, #FBFBFB…) scoped under .swui-scope, not Spring tokens.

sourceClosureNote: The app is a single SPA: src/App.tsx statically imports FeatureSettings.tsx, which statically imports all five tab panels and the AI helper modules. sourceFiles therefore lists the full transitive import graph — identical for every feature — so any manifest alone is a complete, buildable source set. Files primary to this feature carry feature-specific descriptions; the rest are marked (shared closure).
